# Anycode v0.3.0

Anycode v0.3.0 brings major enhancements to code review and diffing with multi-row multibuffer file headers, word-level diff highlights, and binary token ghost line rendering, alongside rich project cards with commit activity charts, standalone `anycode-agent` UI packages, and clean desktop window styling across Linux and Windows.

## Multibuffer & Diff Review

- **Multi-Row File Headers**: Supported multi-row file headers in multibuffer review with pad visual segments for uniform visual scroll calculations (`visualIndex * lineHeight`).
- **File Icons, Relative Paths & Collapse-All**: Added file icons, project-relative folder paths, and a global collapse/expand-all toggle button in multibuffer headers.
- **Word-Level Diff Highlighting**: Sub-line word highlighting inside modified lines to immediately spot changed tokens.
- **High-Performance Deleted Ghost Lines**: Render deleted ghost lines directly from binary tokens without heavy DOM overhead.
- **Optimized Multibuffer Indexing**: Replaced O(N) line scans with O(log M) file ranges and binary search for instant multibuffer operations on large reviews.
- **Selection & Interaction Fixes**: Fixed text selection across deleted diff lines, multibuffer headers, and horizontal scroll pinning.

## Projects & Workspaces

- **Rich Project Cards**: Display commit activity charts, latest commit metadata, and GitHub author avatars.
- **Direct Branch Switching**: Switch git branches directly from project cards in the Projects panel.
- **Workspace Management**: Add new project roots and remove existing projects with one click.
- **Adaptive Layout**: Responsive project cards designed to fit narrow side panels with integrated terminal close actions.

## Desktop Experience (Tauri)

- **Clean Linux & Windows UI**: Disabled the redundant in-window native OS menu bar (`Anycode | File | Edit`) on Linux and Windows, maintaining Anycode's sleek dark aesthetic while keeping the native system menu bar on macOS.

## anycode-agent Package & Showcase

- **Modular `anycode-agent`**: Published standalone `anycode-agent` npm package (1.0.1) with style exports and TypeScript definitions.
- **Agent Demo Showcase**: Added an interactive demo app with model selector, editor-backed diff blocks, transcript fixtures, and dark theme scrollbars.
- **Work Groups UI Polish**: Grouped thoughts next to tool calls into collapsible work groups with cleaner gutters and avatars.

## Editor & Scrolling Performance

- **Trailing Scrollbar Timer**: Replaced `scrollend` event dependencies with responsive trailing timers for reliable scrollbar fade-ins across environments.
- **Smooth Scroll Isolation**: Preserved smooth scrolling by isolating container queries to element wrappers.

**Full comparison:** `v0.2.0...v0.3.0`
